items.criterion: python3 scripts/generate_index.py --validate exits 0 with no Missing refs warning and python3 scripts/validate_refs.py prints All references valid and exits 0
items.detail: Ran both commands fresh in the worktree root. `python3 scripts/generate_index.py --validate` returned exit_code=0 with output: 'Found 497 spec files', '- Missing refs: 0', '✅ All references valid', '✅ No circular dependencies' and NO 'WARNING: ... missing reference targets!' line (that line only prints when missing_refs is non-empty, scripts/generate_index.py:main→generate_index). Gate logic: cmd_validate returns True when missing_refs <= max_missing(0) and no cycles, main maps it to exit 0 (scripts/generate_index.py:cli main, `return 0 if cmd_validate(...) else 1`). Then `python3 scripts/validate_refs.py` returned exit_code=0 and printed exactly 'All references valid.' (scripts/validate_refs.py ends `print("All references valid."); return 0`). [resolution 0.10; scripts/generate_index.py, scripts/validate_refs.py]

items.criterion: The two documented commands form a working, non-mutating sequence: --validate read-only mode leaves the checked-in _index.json intact for validate_refs.py to read
items.detail: Ran the full README-6 sequence in order. generate_index.py --validate printed '(read-only: index computed in memory, _index.json not written)' (generate_index(write=False) skips the write branch), and `ls -la _index.json` showed mtime Nov 16 02:17 — untouched by the run. validate_refs.py then loaded that checked-in index and exited 0. Consistent with README.md:160 which designates --validate as the fail-closed live check.
